quests.title: Whose Pit Is It?
quests.summary: The Heritage Trust wants to turn Big Pit into a theme park. Find out what the valley really wants, and take it to the board.

steps.text: Hear the Heritage Trust's plan for Big Pit from Cerys at the pithead.
Ask Gwilym in the lamp room what he makes of it.
Read the Trust's draft plan pinned in the lamp room.
Shift the tram onto its plate in the old lodge workings and find the Fed's minute book.
Take the minute book to Haf, the archivist in Merthyr library.
Read the visitor book at the Rhondda Heritage Park.
Ask Elwyn at Bethania to raise two choirs, and win Gwenllian Pugh's favour.
Earn a first rank in the Ramblers or the Heritage Trust and tell Prys in Merthyr.
Beat Prys at the Welsh round of the pub quiz: three right or better.
Put it to Cerys at Big Pit and collect the key to the Miners' Hall.
Open the Miners' Hall with Mair and hear the choirs sing.

quests.reward: Cawl, Pwll Mawr cheddar, a Lodge Banner, a Seamknocker and a great deal of standing in Wales.
